review_role: Diagnostic source-and-claim comparison. Reviewer flags require primary-source adjudication; a verdict is not treated as truth by itself.
required_acceptance: No known substantive source omission or unsupported delivered assertion; genuine ambiguity remains explicitly qualified. Structural tests do not certify wording.

budget.unchanged_passes: Carry only with matching item bytes, material evidence dependencies and evaluator configuration.
budget.stall: No unbounded repetition. At stall preserve explicit unresolved limits or withhold the unsupported assertion and record the gap; do not claim complete coverage if a substantive source unit is missing.

statistical_reviewer_false_failure_model.reason: No independently known-correct probabilistic pilot exists. This is a bounded, source-adjudicated research review, not an automated scaled zero-flag acceptance pipeline. No false-failure rate is asserted.

scope_note: Exposure and additional helper-check scope are recorded in the evaluator actual receipts; do not imply complete candidate blinding.
recording_stage: Restatement during initial review; governing scope, source freeze and one-plus-two review budget were already bound in ACTIVE_CONTRACT.json and the immutable candidate before launch.
